mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (session_id, seq, role, content, token_count, created_at, meta) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{role}, #{content}, #{tokenCount}, #{createdAt}, #{meta})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(seq) FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT * FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seq
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
